lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Configurable polygon symbols preserve old styles and match the live native preview
value.statement: Missing option objects preserve old patterns and opacity. Explicit disabled settings override inherited Other options. Procedural textures are periodic, bounded and shared by style with independent pattern alpha and last-owner native cleanup. Dash/cap/join use constant filtered rendering children with normal order, picking and visibility. Advanced MVT styles use the existing classic fallback. The live offline preview uses production native geometry factories and owns its lifecycle. A category modal edits an independent effective clone, leaves the source rule and Other unchanged on Cancel and saves only the chosen category; its separate remove action remains independent. Invalid new inputs block Save; Russian controls and actions remain reachable at large scales.
